name: orbitlens-workspace
description: OrbitLens - Indian Lunar Remote Sensing Portal

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n "frontend,backend,worker" -c "cyan.bold,green.bold,yellow.bold" "npm run dev:frontend" "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:worker"
scripts.dev:all: concurrently -k -n "frontend,backend,worker" -c "cyan.bold,green.bold,yellow.bold" "npm run dev:frontend" "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:worker"
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix frontend install && npm --prefix backend/web-backend install
scripts.build: npm --prefix frontend run build && npm --prefix backend/web-backend run build
scripts.start: concurrently -k -n "frontend,backend,worker" -c "cyan.bold,green.bold,yellow.bold" "npm --prefix frontend start" "npm --prefix backend/web-backend start" "python -m uvicorn app.main:app --app-dir backend/processing-service --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000"
scripts.lint: npm --prefix frontend run lint && npm --prefix backend/web-backend run lint
